item.title: Request for Tree Inspection and Pruning at 26 Timbercroft Lane, 24th October
item.description:
There is a large tree near 26 Timbercroft Lane that requires maintenance. The tree sheds a significant amount of leaves, twigs and other debris, which regularly accumulates on the street and in the area at the front of our property where our bins are kept. This requires frequent clearing and affects the cleanliness of the area. Several branches are overhanging the roof of the property. During heavy rainfall, water is directed onto the roof and into bedroom area via window panels, causing excessive water runoff and concern about potential damage. The roots appear to be affecting the pavement and may eventually cause damage to nearby fence walls. I would be grateful if the tree could be inspected and the overhanging branches trimmed, and if the roots could be assessed for any potential risk to the pavement or surrounding structures.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Timbercroft Lane, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
